description: Register a PayscaleResource (OAuth2 client_credentials grant) wrapping PayScale's Jobalyzer compensation-benchmarking API for use by other components. NOT self-serve -- credentials require a direct commercial agreement with PayScale.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

customer_id.label: Customer ID
customer_id.description: PayScale-issued customer/client identifier, sent as both customerId and user on every request. Issued alongside OAuth2 credentials -- not self-serve.

client_id_env_var.label: Client ID Env Var
client_id_env_var.description: Env var holding the OAuth2 client_credentials client ID.

client_secret_env_var.label: Client Secret Env Var
client_secret_env_var.description: Env var holding the OAuth2 client_credentials client secret.

api_base_url.label: API Base URL
api_base_url.description: Jobalyzer REST API base URL (documented PayScale default).

scope.label: OAuth2 Scope
scope.description: OAuth2 scope requested at the token endpoint.

poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll Interval (seconds)
poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between polling attempts while a report is still processing.

poll_timeout_seconds.label: Poll Timeout (seconds)
poll_timeout_seconds.description: Give up waiting for a report after this many seconds and raise TimeoutError.

name: PayScale Resource
